Hi there,

I'm sorry for the trouble, especially with a deadline today — let's get this sorted quickly.

A few things to check first:
1. Please check your spam/junk folder for an email from noreply@loopwise.com.
2. If you have an email filter or forwarding rule set up, confirm it isn't routing our messages elsewhere.
3. Double-check that you're entering the exact email address associated with your Loopwise account (if you have multiple accounts or use SSO, the reset flow won't send an email).

If none of those explain it, reply to this message with the email address and workspace name you're trying to access, and I'll investigate on our end and manually trigger a reset or unlock your account directly. Given your deadline, I'll prioritize this and get back to you as soon as possible.

Thanks for your patience.

Best,
Loopwise Support
